subject.title: fix(cron): detect ===DONE_ERR=== sentinel in agent final text as failure signal

question: Should terminal assistant-visible `===DONE_ERR===` text be a supported durable cron-failure protocol, or must the isolated-agent producer provide an explicit structured failure signal?
rationale: This choice defines whether presentation text is allowed to control persisted scheduler state and user alerts; moving the parser between callers and helpers cannot safely settle that contract.

options.title: Require a structured producer signal
options.body: Make the producer set a documented fatal signal and keep user-visible final text out of cron-state classification.

options.title: Adopt the terminal sentinel contract
options.body: Document and test `===DONE_ERR===` as an intentional durable cron protocol, including collision and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Require a structured producer signal
recommendation.body: Make the producer set a documented fatal signal and keep user-visible final text out of cron-state classification.

likelyOwner.reason: The introducing cron behavior is the most direct ownership trail available in the supplied evidence; inspect its author and subsequent cron history before assigning the decision.
